meta.title: ed-pdf — free PDF editor for Mac and Windows: edit text, annotate, sign
meta.description: ed-pdf is a free, open-source PDF editor for Mac and Windows. Edit the text of a PDF while keeping its font, annotate, sign, fill in forms and rearrange pages. No account, no subscription, nothing is uploaded.

hero.eyebrow: Free · Open source · Mac and Windows
hero.title: Edit the text of your PDFs, like in a word processor.
hero.lead: ed-pdf fixes a word or rewrites a paragraph while keeping the original font, size and color. It also annotates, signs, fills in forms and rearranges pages, with no account and no subscription.
hero.fineprint: Free, no ads, open source (MIT license)

features.title: Everything you need to work on a PDF
features.lead: One app to read, correct, complete and send your documents.

items.title: Edit text
items.text: Click in a paragraph and edit it in place. Font, size, color and bold are kept and lines reflow; the rest of the page stays untouched.

items.title: Annotate
items.text: Highlight, underline, strike through, add notes, formatted text boxes, drawings, shapes and arrows.

items.title: Sign
items.text: Draw your signature or photograph it on paper: the background is removed automatically. Add stamps (Approved, Paid…) and images too.

items.title: Organize pages
items.text: Reorder by drag and drop, rotate, delete, duplicate, insert other PDFs or images, extract pages.

items.title: Fill in forms
items.text: Complete the fields of PDF forms, with undo at every step.

items.title: Redact
items.text: Hide confidential information: redacted text is really removed from the file, not just covered up.

items.title: Get ready to send
items.text: Create a flattened, lighter copy without your author name, password-protected on Mac. Export pages as images too.

items.title: Read comfortably
items.text: Thumbnails, zoom, single page or continuous scrolling, text search, bookmarks. Undo and redo everywhere.

privacy.title: Your files stay with you
privacy.text: Everything happens on your computer. ed-pdf does not connect to the Internet and sends nothing.

privacy.title: No account, no subscription
privacy.text: No sign-up, no ads, no trial version: every feature is free.

privacy.title: Open and transparent
privacy.text: The source code is public on GitHub under the MIT license: anyone can check what the software does.

privacy.title: In 8 languages
privacy.text: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

download.title: Download ed-pdf
download.mac_req: Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later), macOS 14 or later
download.win_req: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit — a single file, nothing to install
download.first_open: The first time you open it
mac_steps: Open the .dmg file and drag ed-pdf into the Applications folder.
Open ed-pdf: macOS blocks it, because the app is not signed with a paid Apple developer account.
Go to System Settings › Privacy & Security and click “Open Anyway”. You only need to do this once.
win_steps: If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click “More info”, then “Run anyway”. You only need to do this once.
To open your PDFs with ed-pdf: File menu › “Use ed-pdf to open PDFs…”.

support.title: Support the project
support.text: ed-pdf is developed on a volunteer basis and will stay free. If you find it useful, a donation, even a small one, helps keep improving it.

items.a: Yes. Every feature is free, with no ads and no subscription. It is open-source software under the MIT license. Donations are optional.

items.q: Are my documents uploaded to the Internet?
items.a: No. ed-pdf works only on your computer and does not connect to the Internet. Your files are not sent anywhere.

items.q: How do I edit the text of a PDF?
items.a: Choose the “Edit text” tool, click in a paragraph and type your correction. Click elsewhere to confirm; ⌘Z (Mac) or Ctrl+Z (Windows) undoes the change.

items.q: Can I edit the text of a scanned PDF?
items.a: No: a scanned document is an image and contains no editable text. You can still add text boxes, annotate it and sign it.

The signature placed by ed-pdf is an image of your signature. It is fine for many everyday documents, but it is not a certified electronic signature (such as a qualified signature under the EU eIDAS regulation). For documents that require one, use a qualified electronic signature service.

items.q: Why does my Mac or Windows show a warning?
items.a: ed-pdf is not signed with a paid developer certificate. The warning only appears the first time you open it; the source code is public and can be checked on GitHub.
Only edit your own documents, or documents you are authorized to edit. Altering a contract, invoice, diploma or official document without the right to do so is forgery, which is a criminal offense.
